scripts.build: npm run build -w @rulekit/engine && npm run db:generate -w @rulekit/api && npm run build -w @rulekit/api && npm run build -w @rulekit/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rulekit/engine && npm run db:generate -w @rulekit/api && npm test -w @rulekit/engine && npm test -w @rulekit/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run build -w @rulekit/engine && npm run db:generate -w @rulekit/api && npm run build -w @rulekit/api && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed -w @rulekit/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rulekit/engine && npm run db:generate -w @rulekit/api && npm run build -w @rulekit/api && npm run dev:stack
scripts.dev:stack: sh -c 'node apps/api/dist/index.js & api=$!; node apps/api/dist/worker.js & worker=$!; node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev apps/web & web=$!; trap "kill $api $worker $web 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT INT TERM; wait "$web"'
